competition.title: Sample General Knowledge Challenge
competition.description: A 10-question warm-up quiz covering science, geography, technology and history.
competition.instructions: Each question has exactly one correct answer. Wrong answers lose 25% of the question's marks. You can move between questions and change answers until you submit or the timer ends. Your progress is saved automatically.

questions.text: Which planet in our solar system has the most confirmed moons?
questions.explanation: Saturn currently has the largest number of confirmed moons, overtaking Jupiter after a series of discoveries in recent years.

questions.text: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.explanation: Au comes from the Latin word 'aurum'.

questions.text: Which data structure uses First-In-First-Out (FIFO) ordering?
questions.explanation: A queue removes the element that was inserted earliest; a stack is Last-In-First-Out.

questions.text: What is the capital city of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra was purpose-built as the capital as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.text: In HTTP, which status code means 'Not Found'?
questions.explanation: 404 indicates the server cannot find the requested resource.

questions.text: Who wrote the play 'Romeo and Juliet'?
questions.explanation: Romeo and Juliet was written by William Shakespeare in the 1590s.

questions.text: What is the approximate speed of light in a vacuum?
questions.explanation: Light travels at about 299,792 km/s in a vacuum, usually rounded to 300,000 km/s.

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a JavaScript primitive type?
questions.explanation: Objects are reference types. The primitives are string, number, bigint, boolean, undefined, symbol and null.

questions.text: In which year did the Berlin Wall fall?
questions.explanation: The Berlin Wall fell on 9 November 1989.

questions.text: Which gas makes up the largest share of Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen makes up roughly 78% of the atmosphere; oxygen is about 21%.
